Other Character Abilities

Weapon Mastery is optional. Humans receive weapon choices by level; demihumans begin with Basic skill in class-approved weapons. The five ranks are Basic, Skilled, Expert, Master and Grand Master. Each rank improves damage, range, attack bonus, defense or special effects as shown in the Weapon Mastery journal.

The optional General Skills system lets a character choose noncombat skills. Every 1st-level character starts with four blank slots; Intelligence 13-15 grants one extra slot, 16-17 grants two and 18 grants three. A slot is spent when a skill is chosen. Art may be based on Intelligence or Wisdom; skills marked "choose type" record the player's specialty on the sheet.

AbilitySample skills (RC pp. 82-83)
StrengthIntimidation, Muscle, Wrestling
IntelligenceAlchemy, Alternate Magics, Art, Artillery, Craft, Disguise, Engineering, Fire-Building, Healing, Hunting, Knowledge, Labor, Language, Lip Reading, Magical Engineering, Mapping, Military Tactics, Mimicry, Nature Lore, Navigation, Planar Geography, Profession, Science, Shipbuilding, Signaling, Snares, Survival, Tracking, Veterinary Healing
WisdomAnimal Training, Art, Bravery, Caving, Ceremony, Danger Sense, Detect Deception, Gambling, Law and Justice, Mysticism
DexterityAcrobatics, Alertness, Blind Shooting, Cheating, Escape, Mountaineering, Piloting, Quick Draw, Riding, Stealth
ConstitutionEndurance, Food Tasting
CharismaActing, Bargaining, Deception, Leadership, Music, Persuasion, Singing, Storytelling

When the DM decides a skill applies, roll 1d20 against the listed ability score plus any circumstance modifier. A natural 1 is an automatic success and a natural 20 is an automatic failure.

CharacterAdditional slots
Human levels 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25, 29, 33+1 slot at each level
Dwarf level 5, level 9, 1,200,000 XP, +800,000 XP+1 slot at each step
Elf level 5, level 9, 1,350,000 XP, +1,000,000 XP+1 slot at each step
Halfling level 5, 300,000 XP, +1,200,000 XP+1 slot at each step

The character sheet's General Skills tab stores trained skills, specialties and modifiers, and derives the current slot budget from class, level, XP and Intelligence.
